in_sanskrit.name: Nayak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Hero, Commander
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nayak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Marathi culture, Nayak refers to a hero, a leader, or a commander. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nayaka' which means 'one who leads' or 'one who has authority'.
